rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term specifically for a volcanic eruption.

example.english: The news said the volcanic eruption sent lava flowing to the foot of the mountain.
example.traditional: 新聞話嗰座火山爆發，熔岩流到山腳。
example.jyutping: san1 man4 waa6 go2 zo6 fo2 saan1 baau3 faat3 jung4 ngaam4 lau4 dou3 saan1 goek3

rows.note: Use this for a sudden outburst or release of pressure, tension, emotion, or energy rather than a volcano-specific event.

example.english: After holding it in for so long, they finally had an eruption of anger and yelled at everyone.
example.traditional: 佢忍咗咁耐，終於爆發，對住大家大鬧一場。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jan2 zo2 gam3 noi6 zung1 jyu1 baau3 faat3 deoi3 zyu6 daai6 gaa1 daai6 naau6 jat1 coeng4
